audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose was written with male pronouns throughout and framed the lane as generic range-vs-dive.
audit.why: Ahri is female (champ-gender.js) and the lane is specifically gated on Charm (E), a flat 12s cooldown at every rank, not on her mobility in lane — Spirit Rush is 140s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays 7/10; the difficulty is the 12s Charm window, and the pronouns are corrected across tldr, winCon, phases[0-3].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.wave, dosFull/dontsFull titles and report entries.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while win[5] and win[6] read 'Ahri', and the packet flags the chart as contradicting a 52.16% Lux win rate over 5395 games.
audit.why: The full-layer whys for First item and 2+ items both describe Lux winning those stages; the content whys described Ahri winning. Only the level 6 spike (Spirit Rush online, 140s) is a genuine Ahri stage.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stays Ahri; First item and 2+ items become 'Skill' on both layers with matching whys. Spikes: Lost Chapter chip, level 6 Spirit Rush, Luden's Q-E-R deletion, late root-laser control.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive kit interactions were never stated: Orb of Deception's return half deals true damage, and Essence Theft heals her chip back between trades.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says magic on the way out and true damage on the way back, so MR does not price the trade; Essence Theft heals per 9 minions and on takedown, so extended poke wars need Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: breakdown.trading now names the true-damage return, breakdown.mid calls for Oblivion Orb, and breakdown.cooldowns carries real numbers: Charm 12s flat, Fox-Fire 9s at rank 1, Orb 7s, Spirit Rush 140s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Replaced with Charm 12s, Fox-Fire 9s rank 1, Orb 7s, Spirit Rush 140s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now explains Prismatic Barrier timing; dontsFull[2].d explains the 10s Q as the only lockdown.
